(old model).]] Exzhal is a Zandalari troll who was originally a level 60 quest giver on Yojamba Isle in Stranglethorn Vale as a servitor of King Rastakhan. Can be found inside Bag of Fishing Treasures (Terokkar Forest) from Terokkar Forest fishing daily quests.

The Eye of Eternity (also known as EoE) is the final instance of the Nexus in which the final (and only) boss is the blue Dragon Aspect, Malygos. The fight against Malygos is comparable to the fight against Onyxia in that he is a solo raid boss housed within his own instance.
The Eye of Acherus is situated atop Acherus: The Ebon Hold in the Scarlet Enclave next to The Lich King.
__NOTOC__ Exquisite Spider-Silk Footwraps drop from Krik'thir the Gatewatcher in Azjol-Nerub on normal mode.

The Eye of Acherus Control Mechanisms can be found on either side of The Lich King in Acherus: The Ebon Hold while on the quest Death Comes From On High. Players are to control the Eye of Acherus to scope out information on Scarlet-controlled New Avalon.
Exterminate the Intruders is a quest in the Waygate quest chain in Sholazar Basin.
The Eye of the Prophets is taken from the Seer of Zeb'Halak, found on top of the ziggurat at Zeb'Halak.

Completing this achievement is an objective of the meta achievement Desecration of the Alliance. In the horde version, the character must complete Desecrate this Fire! (Horde) for each of the Alliance Bonfires in Eastern Kingdoms.

This article outlines loot dropped in the dungeon Eye of Eternity.
Eydis Darkbane is one of two bosses in the fourth encounter in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance, released in Patch 3.2.
Eye of Zul is an -quality gem which can be obtained through prospecting, transmuting or bought via PvE or PvP tokens. Jewelcrafters are then able to cut the Eye into a wide variety of green jewels.
Eye of the Storm Domination is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning Eye of the Storm 10 times while holding 4 bases.
Eye of the Storm Veteran is a player vs. player achievement earned for completing 100 victories in Eye of the Storm.
Eye of the Storm Victory is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning the Eye of the Storm.
Eye Tentacles are eye stalks summoned by C'Thun in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. In phase 1 of the boss fight they are summoned every 45 seconds while in phase 2 they are summoned every 30 seconds.

This long sheath fits over both a tauren's horns and extends across the head. The sheath is flexible until attached, at which point it gains the color and constency of cold iron.

Eyes of Twilight are communication and control devices used by the Twilight's Hammer. They can be used to maintain control over the minds of those who gaze upon or into them, and in at least one instance, have been able to spy upon the doings of Cho'gall. One Eye of Twilight is a quest item for The Eyes Have It in the Twilight Highlands. Another can be found exercising control over people near Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal during the The Eye of Twilight.
Extra Credit Bonus Stage is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for collecting 5 Golden Orbs in a single visit to the Vortex Pinnacle on Heroic difficulty.

When the Void of the Unmaking collides with Warlord Zon'ozz, it inflicts a distracting shock to him. The Void Diffusion increases the damage Zon'ozz takes. This collision enrages Warlord Zon'ozz, causing him to awaken the Mouth of Go'rath and lose his Focused Anger. In Heroic Difficulty, the awakening of the Maw of Go'rath causes many different types of tentacles to emerge and attack the players. The Eye of Go'rath casts its Shadowy Gaze at a random player, inflicting Shadow damage.

Eyes of Desire is given by Dealer Vijaad of The Consortium in Sethekk Halls. He is located off to the side in Darkweaver Syth's room. Hidden from view of the Sethekk within a barrier, he is looking to hire some help to get rare gems for a buyer: the eyes of the wind serpents inside the dungeon, in exchange for a cut of the profits. Even if players do not notice him right away, he will walk up to them after Darkweaver Syth is killed.

The Eye of the Jailer is one of the core mechanics of the Maw at max level, representing the gaze of the physical entity of the same name. Players are not intended to stay in the zone all day - and the Eye of the Jailer will encourage players to leave once the difficulty ramps up. It resets daily. The mechanic is disabled for players who complete the quest Focusing the Eye in the Chains of Domination campaign, allowing those players to stay in the Maw as long as they like.

.]] "Eyes of the Earth Mother" is a short story by L. L. McKinney published in the anthology Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth. It is illustrated by Cory Godbey. In World of Warcraft, probably every usage of FTW means "For The Win". Elsewhere, FTW could have other meanings. See below for other definitions. Essentially, for the win means that an event or a weapon or talent or skill, etc., is favorable and important. As with any other term, it can be used sarcastically, as in "a real winner." ;Examples: * Pally bubble ftw → "the bubble is what saved me" * Thunderfury FTW → "nothing beats Thunderfury" * LD ftw → "it's always fun to be dropped from server"
Faction recipes are recipes that may be purchased from a vendor upon attaining favorable reputation with a specific faction.

FR is an acronym for fire resistance. For example, if a raid leader tells the raid to wear their FR gear, it means to wear fire resistance gear. FR is also an acronym for flag room, this acronym is used in the Battlegrounds.

Eyonix was a Community Manager at Blizzard Entertainment, specifically for the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/ forums]. He was born August 12, 1979. Eyonix left Blizzard on April 2, 2010. Eyonix, the innkeeper of the Stormspire, is named after him.
Faded Abyssal Crest was used to increase reputation with the Cenarion Circle.

FTL is short for for the loss. It is basically the antonym of for the win. Better stated, perhaps, is to say that it means to say, "This isn't working." ;Example: : "Democracy ftl" → "Democracy isn't serving its purpose"

Almost every time Blizzard introduced a new faction prior to Wrath of the Lich King, they introduced new faction tokens that are used as money to purchase items, or quest objects that are turned in to increase reputation. Those without the patience to grind a single faction exclusively often end up allocating many bag slots to store left-over tokens for when they resume the grind. In cataloging the astounding diversity of these tokens, we can come to grip with the bag-pocalypse confronting the packrats in the community. This page is for items which have no use other than as faction currency or repeatable reputation quests.

The Faction Change service is a paid service offered by Blizzard that allows players to change the faction (Alliance or Horde) of a character. This service is being offered in response to player requests. This service has been designed carefully to avoid disruption of the current gameplay on the realm, so certain restrictions will apply. The current cost is $30 USD, €25 Euros, or £20 GBP per character to switch. The change is permanent, however, after a cooldown period, you can purchase an additional change to go back to the player's original faction.
